caption: The day-1 iron farm: for 18 iron (the hopper, four buckets and the tripwire hooks) and no quartz, three villagers scared by a zombie summon iron golems that burn in lava pits, about 296 iron an hour. Three villagers sleep on their beds in closed 1-cell cobblestone pods under cobblestone slabs; a zombie in a boat 7 blocks north is in view of their standing and sleeping eyes. Golems spawn in a row of 8 1x1 pits west of the zombie, a lava source beside their head on both sides, and burn where they stand. One tripwire runs through every pit at knee height: a golem in any pit opens the trapdoor in front of the zombie, which hides it, and the villagers calm down (at night they fall asleep) while the golem burns. A water channel under the string carries the iron to one hopper. Hide the zombie by hand on the first night: the villagers need a recent sleep to summon the first golem. Built from day-1 materials: cobblestone, cobblestone slabs and torches (no glass, leaves or stone).
